 Kobel: “We’re feeling good and are ready to perform.”
 01:51 The second set of matches in the fourth round of the Champions League is scheduled for Wednesday evening. Gregor Kobel hopes to carry Dortmund’s momentum from the league into this match and secure their third victory.
 Keystone-SDA 
 Today at 05:00 • Today at 19:31 BVB will host Betis Sevilla, one of five teams that remain undefeated in the Champions League after three rounds. The Andalusians are in 4th place in the league behind leader FC Barcelona and the clubs from Madrid.
 But Dortmund is also in good form. Following their strong performance in the 2-2 draw against FC Bayern Munich in the Bundesliga’s top-of-the-table clash, the Black and Yellows are jumping right back into action with a packed schedule featuring nine competitive matches in less than a month.
 “Based on how I see the team and how I feel myself, I have to say we’re all in very good shape athletically. We’re feeling good and are ready to perform every few days,” said Gregor Kobel, who, along with his team, wants to stay in contention for a spot in the top eight and the resulting qualification for the Round of 16.
